title: nil pointers and identity
hints: Dereferencing a nil pointer panics, so check p == nil first. Two pointers are equal only if they point to the same variable.
In Largest, keep a pointer to the best element seen so far, and skip nil entries. Returning &v of a copied value would point to a new variable, not to the caller's one.
var best *int; for _, p := range ptrs { if p != nil && (best == nil || *p > *best) { best = p } }; return best.
